suggestions.message: Non-blocking: extend LOAD-preservation coverage to multiple PT_LOAD entries interleaved with non-LOAD entries, zero-file-size BSS, and nonzero virtual-address alignment residues. The current synthetic source has one LOAD; the reviewed production ELF also has one LOAD. Rename the append-only test to describe repacking.

Non-blocking hardening for future untrusted input: cap accepted LOAD alignment/output size before allocating padding and explicitly validate that a checksum-valid Multiboot header remains within the first 8192 bytes after repacking. The current trusted production ELF has 4096-byte alignment and its header remains at offset 4096 in every verified fixture.
Non-blocking: add mocked coverage for successful failure-VGA capture and capture exceptions, confirming both retain FAIL and still execute cleanup.

summary: PASS for the bounded GRUB fixture repack and scenario failure/cleanup review against the fingerprinted current sources and trusted production ELF; this is not full fresh acceptance.

focus: build_fixture: ELF header/table construction, bounded arithmetic, LOAD preservation and trampoline placement
run_scenario: fail-closed reporting, pre-cleanup failure capture, independent owned-process reaping and post-exit media hashing
host test coverage for these paths
scope.restrictions_observed: No source edits, build, QEMU launch, or commit. Only the requested review JSON was written. Constructor checks executed entirely in memory with Python bytecode writes disabled.

verification.in_memory_constructor_result: PASS: all 11 fixtures at both 128 and 512 MiB preserve exact original LOAD bytes and all original LOAD fields except file offset; offsets satisfy alignment congruence; program table begins at 52 and ends within 8192; section table is one real 40-byte null entry; checksum-valid aligned Multiboot header remains at offset 4096.
verification.arithmetic_review: Python integer arithmetic does not silently wrap. Existing parse_elf bounds file ranges and identity LOAD physical ends to the ELF32 address space. Fixed scratch-region exclusion covers metadata, growth probe, module and the actual sub-page trampoline payload. Current source entry displacement fits signed rel32. Packing errors on unsupported values fail construction rather than publishing a fixture success.
verification.cleanup_review: Workload exceptions append a failed check before attempting VGA capture. Capture errors are retained. close failures force FAIL, and the captured Popen is independently killed if running and waited with a five-second bound. Full recovery-media comparison occurs only after confirmed process exit. No-check workloads and any failed checks cannot publish PASS.
verification.existing_guest_evidence_result: Read aggregate and both exact child reports: aggregate PASS, 2/2 requested ISO scenarios at 128 MiB; nomodule 34/34 checks PASS; invalidmagic 42/42 checks PASS; both owned processes exited. Invalidmagic full recovery-image before/after SHA256 matches. Production ELF preservation and owned-stage removal are recorded PASS.
verification.host_suite: Reviewed host test source; the supplied 14-test PASS was not rerun during this bounded review.
verification.acceptance_limit: Existing live evidence covers only ISO nomodule and invalidmagic at 128 MiB. The full fresh acceptance matrix remains the caller's responsibility; no broader guest acceptance is asserted.
